Not quite—the “$+1$” is part of the **exponent**, so use the exponent rule to rewrite Quantity A:

$$2^{x+1}=2^x\cdot 2.$$

Quantity B is $2^x\cdot 4$. Since $2^x$ is positive for every integer $x$, both quantities share the same positive factor. Compare the remaining factors, $2$ and $4$: which quantity is greater?

The factor $4$ doesn’t become irrelevant when $x$ is large; both quantities grow by the same factor $2^x$.
